newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine flour mills buy 18,900T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine flour mills buy 18,900T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour millers bought 18,900 tonnes of U.S. western white wheat at $188 to $189 per tonne through trading firm Mitsui and Co Ltd, traders said on Thursday.
They said Philippine millers also asked for quotations for another 21,100 tonnes of U.S. dark northern spring wheat with 13.5 percent and 14 percent protein content.
"The U.S. western white wheat transaction is for October delivery," one trader said.
Philippine flour mills were out of the market last week on expectations that wheat prices would soften further due to better harvests in the European Union.
Manila traders said local flour millers started asking for quotations late on Wednesday after prices in Chicago and Minneapolis, where the Philippines buy its wheat requirements, softened.
